critical_code_review_comments: Revenue split calculation is correctly implemented: 25% platform fee first, then 60/40 split of net (resulting in 45% creator / 30% platform of gross)
Contract HTML generation includes all required sections: Recitals, Revenue Sharing table, Payment Terms, Tax Obligations, Content Rights, Exclusivity, Term & Termination, Signatures
VAT/Tax handling has 3 options: creator_responsible (recommended), platform_withholds, gross_up
